return_conditions.title: 1. Return conditions
return_conditions.text: We accept returns within **14 days** from the date of receiving the order. The customer has the right to inspect the product in the same way as in a physical store. The product must be returned in a condition suitable for resale. The seller has the right to reduce the refund amount if the product has been used beyond what is necessary to establish its nature, characteristics, and functioning.

how_to_return.title: 2. How to return a product?
steps: Provide the order number and the reason for the return
Send the product to our warehouse (address will be provided by the operator)

exceptions.title: 3. Exceptions to the return policy
exceptions.text: Some products **cannot be returned** if they:
list: Show signs of use beyond what is necessary for inspection (in such cases, the refund amount may be reduced)
Belong to the category of personal hygiene products supplied in sealed packaging (for example, headphones, razors), if the packaging has been opened after delivery

refunds.title: 4. Refunds
refunds.text: After inspecting the returned product, we will process the refund within **5–10 business days**. The refund will be made to the same payment method used for the purchase.
details: When returning a product under the 14-day right of withdrawal, the seller refunds the cost of the product and the cost of standard delivery to the customer.
The cost of returning the product to the seller is borne by the customer, unless the return is due to a defect or an error on the seller’s part.
If the product is defective or does not correspond to the order, all delivery and return costs are covered by the seller.

warranty.title: 5. Warranty
warranty.text: The warranty applies only to products covered by a manufacturer’s warranty. If a manufacturer’s warranty is provided, the customer may contact an authorized service center or the seller. The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, consumables, or damage caused by improper use.
